prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent front equipment layer for a layered children's game avatar
Input images: Image 1 is the exact canonical horse body and coordinate reference; Image 2 is the existing rear cloak layer whose blue, violet, silver, star embroidery, folds, and trailing drape must be continued; Image 3 is the current browser composite showing the rear layer behind the exact horse.
Primary request: Create ONLY the missing FRONT portion of the same moon/star cloak, fitted precisely to the exact horse in Image 1. Add a clearly visible curved yoke resting around the lower neck and both shoulders, a small silver-violet clasp at the front/side of the neck, and a believable blue-violet fabric panel lying over the horse's visible left back and outer left flank. The visible front panel must connect naturally to the rear drape in Image 2 when layered together.
Composition: preserve the exact 1024 x 1536 canonical canvas and exact horse coordinates from Image 1. The equipment layer must already be aligned at full canvas scale; do not require translation, scaling, cropping, bbox normalization, or rotation. Keep the horse's face, eyes, muzzle, mane, ears, all four legs and hooves fully free. Stop the front fabric above the leg joints. Keep the yoke below the mane line and away from the face. The layer may cover a modest part of the torso/back so it reads as worn cloth, but must not cover most of the body.
Style: polished painterly premium magical children's adventure illustration matching Images 1-3; deep midnight blue and silver-violet cloth, restrained embroidered stars, silver edging, coherent lighting.
Transparency: output a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Include ONLY the new front equipment pixels. The horse, mane, tail, body, legs, hooves, eyes, all existing equipment, checkerboard, glow, shadow, and backdrop must be absent and fully transparent.
Constraints: one equipment layer only; clean alpha edges; full canonical canvas; no labels, no text, no watermark; no full horse; no new figure; no saddle; no headpiece; no hoof jewelry; no floating ornaments.
Avoid: animal pixels or silhouette, background, black fill, white fill, checkerboard painted into the image, detached fabric, fabric crossing face or legs, oversized blanket hiding the torso, duplicated rear cloak.
provenance: Original body-specific built-in image_gen front layer generated from the exact horse body, existing rear layer, and previous browser composition.

qa.method: Headless Edge composition from decoded PNGs on the canonical canvas at 1024 px and responsive 320 px.
qa.observedFit: The yoke follows the lower neck, the clasp is visibly attached at the right chest edge, and the front cloth covers the left back and flank while the face, all four lower legs, and all hooves remain visible. The long left drape overlaps the rear layer without exposing a second outer contour.
